title: Memory is distributed
governingQuestion: What survives when fashion memory is split across institutions and commercial platforms?

beats.direction: Use the recurring witness with an on-screen disclaimer: CITY CONTEXT / NOT DAY-SPECIFIC.
beats.voice: Shanghai compresses schedule, factory-city, social image, cloud runway, buyer order, product identity and distributed memory into synchronized platform time. This chapter follows memory: The venue disappears, schedules change and links decay; preservation choices determine which technical history remains citable and contestable.
beats.onScreen: Then: Donghua University’s textile-and-costume museum and the Shanghai Municipal Archives expose different institutional routes into material and civic memory.

beats.voice: The distinction is material. A polished interface can survive after its workers, contracts, specifications or permission trail disappear, leaving the audience with an outcome but not its operating history.
beats.onScreen: Next: No complete public archive was located that preserves every Shanghai show’s invitations, worker credits, venue plans, source files, rights, platform metrics and commercial outcomes.
